column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A to CIS Controls v8 Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A reference controls (93 permissible values of the AnnexAControlId enum) and the Center for Internet Security Critical Security Controls v8 (18 Controls and their Safeguards). Class-level anchor mappings link the InformationSecurityManagementSystem and SecurityControl classes to the CIS Controls document and Safeguard concept. Per-control mappings use skos:closeMatch where one CIS Safeguard substantively implements an Annex A control, skos:relatedMatch where coverage is partial or implementation-flavoured, and skos:broadMatch where the CIS Control is broader than the Annex A control. Physical and HR-only Annex A controls without direct CIS technical analogues are intentionally omitted. Cross-references reflect the publicly documented CIS Controls v8 to ISO/IEC 27002:2022 mapping guidance.
